title: A Little Hello for the Hills
originalStory: Mila and Dad waved toward the faraway hills, but the shy echo answered their hello in a tiny whisper. Mila called, “You’re welcome here!” and waited while the echo practiced saying the kind words back. When it finally said the whole sentence, Mila smiled and whispered, “Thank you.”
visualBible:
Mila: human child, age 5, small stature, normal human ears, warm brown skin, dark curly hair in two short puffs, yellow cardigan, purple trousers, white sneakers.
Dad: adult man, age 35, tall with broad shoulders, normal human ears, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, neat dark beard, teal sweater, tan trousers, brown shoes.

pages.text: Mila and Dad waved toward the faraway hills from the garden gate: “Hello!” A tiny “hello” floated back, soft as a moth’s wing. “Oh,” Mila whispered, “I think our echo is shy.”
pages.illustrationScene: Warm cartoon illustration in a wide landscape composition. Mila, recognizable by two dark hair puffs and a yellow cardigan, and Dad, a tall bearded adult in a teal sweater, stand together at a garden gate on flat grass, waving toward distant rounded hills. The gate opens onto a broad, level meadow, with no road, water, steep drop, or other hazard nearby. Soft curved marks over the distant hills suggest the tiny returning sound; the echo has no body or face. The mood is gentle wonder.

pages.text: At the low garden bench, Mila cupped her hands around her mouth and called, “You’re welcome here!” “Here,” came the little answer. Dad sat beside her and smiled: “We’ve got time.”
pages.illustrationScene: Warm cartoon illustration with a close view of a low wooden bench on level grass inside the garden. Mila sits securely beside Dad, cupping empty hands around her mouth to call toward the faraway hills. Mila has warm brown skin, normal human ears, two dark hair puffs, a yellow cardigan, purple trousers, and white sneakers. Dad is clearly a tall adult man with warm brown skin, normal human ears, short dark curls, a neat beard, a teal sweater, tan trousers, and brown shoes; Dad smiles patiently at Mila. The mood is welcoming and unhurried.

pages.text: Across the meadow, the shy echo tried again: “Welcome here.” The hills held a hush, with only the grass going shhh in the breeze. Then, a little clearer, came the whole sentence: “You’re welcome here!”
pages.illustrationScene: Warm cartoon landscape illustration focused entirely on the broad meadow and faraway rounded hills under a soft blue sky. No characters are visible. Sunlit grass bends gently in the breeze, and delicate curved sound marks travel back from the hills to suggest the echo practicing its welcoming words. Do not give the hills or the echo eyes, faces, limbs, or bodies. The mood is quiet anticipation turning into a small, joyful success.

pages.text: Mila smiled and whispered, “Thank you.” A tiny “thank you” slipped back, and Dad’s shoulder gave a soft little shake as he chuckled. Mila leaned against him on the bench, leaving a cozy patch of sunshine beside them for the next hello.
pages.illustrationScene: Warm cartoon illustration of Mila and Dad sitting securely close together on the low garden bench, surrounded by level grass in golden afternoon light. Mila, the small human child with normal human ears, warm brown skin, two dark hair puffs, a yellow cardigan, purple trousers, and white sneakers, smiles and leans against Dad. Dad, the tall adult man with normal human ears, warm brown skin, short dark curls, a neat beard, a teal sweater, tan trousers, and brown shoes, chuckles warmly. An empty sunlit space remains beside Mila on the bench; distant rounded hills appear softly in the background. The mood is safe, tender, and quietly delighted.
